extraction.name: PASTIS
extraction.description: The first open-access Satellite Image Time Series (SITS) dataset with panoptic annotations for pixel-precise panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels, containing over 2 billion annotated pixels covering over 4000 km².
extraction.creator: Vivien Sainte Fare Gamot and Loic Landrieu
extraction.publisher: LASTIG, Univ. Gustave Eiffel, ENSG, IGN
extraction.rai:dataCollection: PASTIS is a satellite image time series dataset collected from the Sentinel constellation for agricultural parcel monitoring. The dataset contains multi-temporal satellite imagery with panoptic annotations for agricultural parcels, capturing temporal patterns of crop phenology throughout yearly cycles.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Varying cloud cover can make analysis difficult and affect data availability
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multi-temporal satellite imagery from Sentinel constellation satellites, containing multi-spectral data capturing agricultural parcels over yearly time periods
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Agricultural parcels were annotated with panoptic annotations including centerpoints, bounding boxes, binary instance masks, and semantic classes for each parcel
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Remote monitoring of agricultural parcels has major financial and environmental implications, including fair allocation of agricultural subsidies (50 and 22 billion euros per year in Europe and the US, respectively) and ensuring best crop rotation practices are respected.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is designed for panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from satellite image time series, with applications including crop mapping, monitoring agricultural subsidies allocation, ensuring crop rotation practices, and more generally for surveying urban development and deforestation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and implementation are publicly available. A bug fix was released for the metric computation, with details available at github.com/VSainteuf/utae-paps/issues/11.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images are embedded by a shared multi-level spatial convolutional encoder with convolutions, ReLu activations, and normalizations. Group Normalization with 4 groups is used instead of Batch Normalization in the encoder to address non-identical distribution of samples acquired at different times.
